title: Typing in chat
description: An animated typing indicator appears above the player's head and in the Tab list while typing in chat.

title: Inventory open
description: Shows when a player has their survival or creative inventory open, with matching arm pose.

title: Using a crafting table
description: Shows when a player is using a crafting table or other work block.

title: Looking inside a chest
description: Shows when a player has a chest, barrel, shulker box or ender chest open.

title: AFK with a timer
description: Shows when a player is away from the keyboard, together with how long they have been idle.
